[LSER.10.13] **Identity slot designation via `by:`.** Every
series binds to one identity slot, and that is a permanent
property of a series rather than a v1 limit. With `by:` omitted, a
`logical` schema takes its declared identity `key` slot when it has
exactly one ([LFAC.1.7], [LSER.7.6.1]); a composite key resolves to
nothing and must be narrowed with `by:`. A schema of any other lifecycle
declares no identity ([LFAC.1.7.6]) and must name `by:` explicitly.
Otherwise the declaration must qualify with `by: <slot>` or
opt into a single global allocation with `by: none`, and a
series with no resolvable identity is
`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_IDENTITY_SLOT`.
Which lifecycles a series may be declared on is [LSER.7.6.3].
